verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a public API reference for the Sandbox SDK. It covers commands (exec, streaming via SSE, stdin), files (read/write/mkdir/streams), the code interpreter, ports/preview URLs, sessions, watch, and getSandbox, so the product can be driven programmatically end to end. The API is an SDK called from a Worker/Durable Object rather than a standalone REST endpoint, and the OpenAPI probe is site-wide rather than shown to be sandbox-specific. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, a confirmed sandbox-specific REST/OpenAPI surface callable without deploying a Worker

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: sandbox.exec() - Execute shell commands in the sandbox and capture stdout, stderr, and exit codes.
getSandbox() - Gets or creates a sandbox instance by ID. Use a stable ID to reconnect to the same sandbox.
Execute a command and return a Server-Sent Events stream for real-time processing.
Read, write, and manage files in the sandbox filesystem. All paths are absolute (e.g., `/workspace/app.js`).
Expose a port and get a preview URL for accessing services running in the sandbox.
